body.message:
Hi 

I’m Pooja, founder of a creative design and solutions business , specialising in creating distinctive brand experiences for real-estate companies.

We work with real-estate brands from concept and creative design to final physical execution, helping them maintain a consistent and premium brand presence across their customer journey.

Our services include:

1.Property Marketing
• Brochures
• Flyers
• Project catalogues
• Leaflets
• Property marketing creatives

2. Sales Material
• Presentation folders
• Sales kits
• Property information folders
• Sales presentation material

3. Site Branding
• Hoardings
• Banners
• Standees
• Directional signage
• Site-specific branding

4.Project Launch
• Launch invitations
• Creative invitation boxes
• Launch backdrops
• Event displays
• Project-launch branding

5. Digital Creatives
• Social media posts
• Reels & campaign creatives
• Digital advertisements
• WhatsApp creatives
• Project-specific digital campaigns

6. Customer Gifting
• Booking gifts
• Possession gifts
• Festive gifts
• Client appreciation gifts
• Premium customised gifting

7. Key Handover
• Branded key boxes
• Key pouches
• Welcome folders
• Custom key-handover experiences

8. Welcome Kits
• Homeowner welcome boxes
• Document folders
• Housewarming gifts
• Move-in kits
• Customised welcome experiences

9. Channel-Partner Gifting
• Premium gift boxes for brokers
• Referral-partner gifts
• Festive gifting
• Customised partner kits

10. Office & Sales-Office Creatives
• Reception branding
• Sales-office displays
• Presentation boards
• Wall graphics
• Customer-facing displays

11. Model & Presentation Material
• Project model displays
• Floor-plan boards
• Sample-material boards
• Material presentation kits
• Project presentation displays

12. Print Collateral
• Business cards
• Letterheads
• Envelopes
• Certificates
• Other branded stationery

Our focus is not just on designing individual products, but on creating a cohesive creative experience aligned with the project's brand identity, positioning and target customer .

I would love to understand your upcoming projects and explore how we could create something customised for your brand.

Could we schedule a short meeting/presentation? I’d be happy to bring a few creative concepts and ideas specifically relevant to your projects.

Regards,
Pooja
